soldier: Head yellow, the frontal region brown, the anterior half of the mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale yellow; the flange over the antennal socket and the basal segments of the antennae brown, becoming paler towards the apex, the body pale yellowish white except for the darker margins of the pronotum. Head capsule rectangular and narrow, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle pore very small, about 0.03 mm in diameter. Labrum semicircular, the labral apex bluntly rounded, the labral margin semi-transparent and bearing long setae. The outer margin of the mandibles curves in a broad arc, the apices slightly incurved; the middle to lower part of the inner margin of both mandibles bears a small triangular tooth, that of the right mandible slightly nearer the base; the base of the left mandible has a large process whose anterior notch is nearly a right angle, while the base of the right mandible has a rounded process. Antennae 12–14-segmented, segment 1 equal to or slightly longer than segment 3; the flange over the antennal socket very large, able to conceal the lateral margins of the head completely. The broad part of the postmentum bears punctate sculpture at the centre and is exposed beyond the lower margin of the head in lateral view. The anterior margin of the pronotum is shallowly concave, the posterior margin markedly concave, the lateral margins narrowing backwards, the femora inflated.
